name: Imposter
summary: A party game: everyone gets the same secret word but one, drops a one-word clue, then votes out the faker.
useWhen: the chat is bored and wants a quick game everyone can play from their phone
dontUseWhen: fewer than 3 people in the chat

params.crew: what the chat calls itself in copy, e.g. 'girls'
params.pairs: 1-6 x {word, odd, hints[3], oddHints[3]}: the crowd's word, the imposter's word, clue suggestions for each
params.imposter: member name who has the odd word in round 1
params.clues: {by, text}[]: round 1 clues already in the chat
